email_subject: Application for Stage Marketing & Social Media at Summit
email_body:
Dear Summit Team,

I am writing to apply for the Stage Marketing & Social Media internship. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media integration, I am excited about the opportunity to support Summit's mission of elevating Belgian and Flemish podcasts.

In my current role at Episto, I create and publish keyword-targeted content, manage WordPress sites, and track performance using analytics tools. On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a website with integrated social media, and I regularly engage with audiences online. I am comfortable with tools like Canva and have a foundational understanding of marketing strategy and audience analysis.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I am currently improving my Dutch (B1) while working professionally in English. I am enthusiastic about the local media landscape and eager to contribute to community engagement and marketing campaigns.

I would love to discuss how my skills can support Summit's growing audio community. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Summit Team,

I am excited to apply for the Stage Marketing & Social Media internship at Summit. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, social media integration, and audience engagement, I am drawn to Summit's mission of elevating Belgian and Flemish podcasts. I am eager to contribute to your community and help promote high-quality audio content.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in planning and publishing content across digital channels. I write SEO-driven blog posts, manage WordPress sites, and track performance using tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush. This has taught me how to adapt messaging to different audiences and measure the impact of marketing activities.

On my own project, mirook.com, I designed and built a website for a Belgian youth chess champion, integrating social media feeds and creating content to engage followers. This hands-on experience has strengthened my skills in content creation, basic design with Canva, and community interaction. I understand the importance of consistent, engaging social media presence to build a loyal audience.

I am particularly interested in the research aspect of this role. I enjoy analyzing audience behavior and trends to inform marketing strategies. My technical background in SEO and web analytics allows me to derive insights from data and apply them creatively.

Fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 and improving, I am well-prepared to communicate with diverse audiences in Belgium's media landscape. I am organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in hybrid environments.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my enthusiasm for podcasts and digital marketing to Summit. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
